terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using our service, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. Please read them carefully.

items.service: Primeshot / Service: The AI-powered platform that generates headshots from user-uploaded selfies.
items.user: User / You: Anyone accessing or using Primeshot.
items.userContent: User Content: Any images, selfies, or other content you upload to Primeshot.
items.aiGenerated: AI-Generated Content / Headshots: Images produced by Primeshot’s AI models based on your User Content.
items.credits: Credits: Units used to pay for AI model training or image generation.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility
eligibility.content: You must be at least 16 years old to use Primeshot. By using the Service, you confirm that you meet this age requirement.

userAccounts.title: 3. User Accounts
items: You must create an account to use Primeshot.
You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account.
Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access.

payments.title: 4. Payments and Subscriptions
payments.content: All payments are processed online via secure payment providers. Subscription fees are charged upfront; credits expire per plan terms and do not roll over. Failed payments may result in suspension until resolved.
payments.refunds: No refunds for unused credits or mid-cycle changes, except for technical failures in generating images.
payments.priceChanges: Primeshot may change fees or credit pricing at any time; existing subscriptions are unaffected until renewal.

ownership.title: 5. User Content and Ownership
ownership.content: You retain all ownership rights to your uploaded images and AI-generated headshots. You grant Primeshot a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use your User Content solely for delivering the Service. You are solely responsible for the content you upload and any consequences thereof.

prohibitedContent.title: 6. Prohibited Content
prohibitedContent.intro: You may not upload content that:
items: Is illegal, abusive, harassing, defamatory, or threatening
Contains nudity, sexually explicit, or pornographic material
Promotes hate speech, violence, or discrimination
Infringes third-party intellectual property or rights
prohibitedContent.note: Primeshot may remove any content violating these rules without notice.

aiGenerated.title: 7. AI-Generated Content
aiGenerated.content: AI headshots are generated based on your User Content. While we aim for high-quality results, Primeshot does not guarantee likeness accuracy or style fidelity. You accept that AI outputs may vary, include imperfections, or reflect biases inherent in AI models. Primeshot is not liable for any personal, professional, or commercial use outcomes of AI-generated content.

privacy.title: 8. Privacy and Data Handling
privacy.content: Uploaded images and AI-generated models are private and not shared or sold. Data is stored securely and deleted after 60 days following account termination unless legally required to retain it longer. By using the Service, you consent to our Privacy Policy regarding data collection and processing.

ip.title: 9. Intellectual Property
ip.content: Primeshot retains ownership of all AI models, software, and technology used to provide the Service. You may not reverse-engineer, copy, or reproduce any Primeshot technology.

liability.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Primeshot and its affiliates are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages from using the Service, errors, inaccuracies, or imperfections in AI-generated content, or loss of data, profits, or business opportunities.

indemnity.title: 11. Indemnity
indemnity.content: You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Primeshot and its officers, directors, employees, and agents from any claims, liabilities, damages, or expenses arising from your use of the Service, your User Content, or violation of these Terms.

termination.title: 12. Termination
termination.content: Primeshot may suspend or terminate accounts for violations of these Terms. Users may terminate their account at any time; data is deleted after 60 days. Termination does not release you from any payment obligations incurred prior.

law.title: 13. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
law.content: These Terms are governed by UK law. Any disputes will be resolved under UK jurisdiction. Parties agree to attempt informal resolution before pursuing legal action.

changes.title: 14. Changes to Terms
changes.content: Primeshot may update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

items.severability: Severability: If any part of these Terms is found invalid, the remainder remains in effect.
items.entireAgreement: Entire Agreement: These Terms, together with the Privacy Policy, constitute the full agreement between you and Primeshot.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Primeshot, your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use our service. By using Primeshot, you consent to the practices described here.

collect.title: 1. Information We Collect

items.account: Account Information: Name, email address, and social login details if you sign up via Google or similar services.
items.userContent: User Content: Selfies and AI-generated headshots.
items.device: Device and Usage Data: Browser type, device type, IP address, and app usage statistics.

collect.note: Note: We do not collect or store payment information. Payments are handled securely by Stripe.

use.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
use.intro: We use the information you provide solely to:
items: Provide and improve our AI headshot service.
Monitor technical performance and troubleshoot issues.
use.note: We do not use your data for marketing purposes or share it with third parties for advertising.

thirdParty.title: 3. Third-Party Services

items.aws: AWS: For secure storage and processing of your uploaded selfies and AI-generated headshots.
items.stripe: Stripe: For secure subscription payments and credit purchases.

thirdParty.note: We ensure that third-party providers comply with privacy and security requirements.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies only for social login functionality. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.

retention.title: 5. Data Retention
retention.content: Uploaded selfies and AI-generated headshots are stored while your account is active. After account deletion, data is retained for 60 days for recovery purposes and an additional 30 days in backups. After this period, all data is permanently deleted.

security.title: 6. Data Security
security.intro: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse, including:
items: Encrypted storage of files on AWS.
Secure transmission of data using HTTPS.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.intro: Under UK and EU data protection laws, you have the right to:
items: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction or deletion of your personal data.
Object to or restrict certain processing of your data.
rights.contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {{email}}.

children.title: 8. Children
children.content: Primeshot is not intended for individuals under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

changes.title: 9. Changes to this Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of any updates.

contact.title: 10. Contact Us
contact.content: For questions or concerns regarding your privacy or this policy, contact us at: {{email}}.
